disclaimer: MODELED values are transparent engineering judgments mapped from OBSERVED claims. Not scientifically calibrated.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: TSMC CEO 2Q26: packaging capacity is so tight it limits customers' growth; 3Q25 already called AI frontend/backend very tight. Expansion announcements are not treated as surplus.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: 2Q26: backend still in shortage mode and the gap is bigger; company working to shorten demand-capacity gap. 4Q25: AP revenue >10% and growing faster than corporate — demand is pulling capacity, not the reverse.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: 13 Taiwan leading-edge/AP fabs and Arizona AP are multi-year builds (2Q26). Secondary ~80% CAGR CoWoS 2022–2027 is real growth that still lags stated shortage.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Leading-edge CoWoS-class AI packaging remains dominated by TSMC; Wei welcomes EMIB-T as flexibility, not as a drop-in for current flagship packages.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Shortage-mode language and 'limits customer growth' imply continued allocation; no surplus or short-lead declaration on 2Q26 call.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Multi-die + HBM packages raise yield complexity; not claimed as the primary stated bottleneck vs capacity.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: CoWoS is in high-volume production; maturity high relative to CPO/SoIC leading edge.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Customer qualification and allocation stickiness make switching packagers slow.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Intel EMIB-T / OSAT alternatives exist for some designs. 2Q26 Wei treats them as extra market flexibility to unstick frontend wafers — not as equivalent CoWoS for current AI flagships.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Major CoWoS capacity concentrated in Taiwan AP sites; Arizona packaging announced but later.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Almost every leading AI accelerator attach path depends on CoWoS-class packaging + HBM.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Three primary TSMC transcripts (3Q25, 4Q25, 2Q26) now state tightness, then shortage that limits customer growth. Exact WPM still not officially disclosed.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Vera Rubin-class platforms designed around HBM4. SK hynix 2Q26 primary: customer demand exceeds supply capabilities; LTAs with ~10 customers. Three-supplier MP does not equal slack.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: SK began HBM4 mass shipments in 2Q26 and is ramping H2; Micron FQ3-26 in HVP for lead customer; Samsung commercial MP Feb 2026. All three ramping into a market they still describe as short.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: M15X acceleration, P&T7 packaging, Yongin, Micron HVP, and Samsung HBM4 capacity expansion are real. 2Q26 SK still frames delivery of requested volume as the scarce capability.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Three makers now in HBM4 volume (SK, Micron, Samsung). Still a three-name market; qualification stickiness remains.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Allocation / partnership language and demand>capacity statements imply constrained lead times.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: SK indicates HBM4 yield/quality approaching HBM3E maturity on ramp; residual new-node risk remains.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: 12H in volume; 16H still sampling/qualification — mid maturity.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Accelerator vendors qualify specific stacks; switching suppliers is slow.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: No near-term substitute for HBM bandwidth/capacity in package; GDDR/LPDDR not equivalent.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Korea-centric with US packaging expansions starting; Micron adds geographic diversity.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Next-gen accelerator roadmaps explicitly pair to HBM4.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary 2Q26 SK (demand exceeds supply; Q2 HBM4 shipments), Micron FQ3-26 HVP, and Samsung Feb 2026 commercial MP. Three-year demand>capacity remains secondary.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: SK hynix: HBM revenue more than doubled YoY in FY25; HBM3E remains main volume product alongside HBM4 ramp.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Company maximizing HBM capacity (M15X) amid supply-demand imbalance; still allocating between HBM and conventional DRAM.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Fab expansions underway but HBM wafer intensity limits effective bit growth.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Three suppliers; SK hynix positioned as leading stable HBM3E+HBM4 supplier.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Cannot freely substitute other DRAM classes for HBM3E attach.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Current accelerator fleets still HBM3E-heavy during transition.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary FY25 results; exact industry capacity shares not officially tabulated.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Every HBM3E/HBM4 stack needs a base die; volume scales with HBM cubes.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Samsung HBM4 uses a 4nm logic base die; Micron HBM4 uses an in-house CMOS base-die path. Base die is a distinct manufacturing surface from DRAM wafers, still thinly quantified.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Improves with HBM fab ramps; not independently disclosed.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Tied to the three HBM makers (+ foundry partners for some gens).
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Inferred from stack lead times; weaker direct disclosure.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Interface logic complexity and stacking interactions.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Mature for HBM3E; evolving for HBM4/custom.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Base die is integral to the stack; not independently substitutable.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Samsung primary (4nm logic base die) plus Micron HBM4 architecture. Capacity metrics still thinly disclosed.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: 12H volume and 16H sampling (Micron/SK) raise stacking intensity per cube.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: SK building advanced packaging in Cheongju and Indiana for front+back-end integration — stacking/back-end treated as strategic capacity.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Packaging sites ramping; still catching demand.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Stacking largely captive to HBM makers.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Taller stacks increase bonding yield risk; 16H still in qual/samples.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Customer qual for stack height/speed bins.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: No alternate stacking path for JEDEC HBM cubes.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Determines bits and bandwidth per package site.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Company packaging investments primary; detailed stacking yields not public.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Each cube requires KGS test; scales with HBM output.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Not directly quantified in filings; inferred process dependency.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Captive to HBM makers + ATE ecosystem.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Established flows for HBM3E; adapting for HBM4.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Cannot skip stack test for AI reliability targets.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: HBM test capacity is located with maker back-end sites in Korea and expanding US packaging footprints.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK — structural inference, few direct public capacity claims.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: CoWoS packages require interposers sized for multi-HBM; demand tracks CoWoS tightness.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Bundled inside TSMC advanced packaging constraint set on earnings calls.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Leading-edge silicon interposer capacity concentrated at TSMC for AI flagships.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Silicon interposers for CoWoS-class packages are production-proven at leading-edge AI volumes.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Leading-edge AI interposer capacity remains concentrated in Taiwan advanced packaging sites.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Strong dependency logic; less standalone primary metrics than CoWoS headline.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Large AI packages increase substrate area/layer demand with CoWoS ramps.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: 2Q26 Wei: majority still CoWoS; glass-core/substrate alternatives ~1 year from production; TSMC working with substrate vendors so customers can ship. Not a 2026 relief.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Supplier expansions ongoing; not TSMC-owned solely.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Fewer qualified advanced substrate makers for large AI packages.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Historically long substrate lead times for high-layer counts.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Mature industry with advancing layer counts.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Limited drop-in substitutes for high-end AI substrates.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Blocks package completion after die attach.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: 2Q26 primary: glass substrate still ~1 year from maturity. Capacity still not quantified; WPM estimates remain secondary.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: TSMC SoIC / hybrid bonding called out as fast-growing with AI 3D stacking; C.C. Wei cites TSMC-SoIC in NVIDIA CPO collaboration.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Secondary: SoIC capacity still small vs CoWoS (tens of k WPM targets) while demand for denser stacking rises.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Reported ~90% CAGR SoIC capacity ambitions through 2027 (secondary summarizing TSMC).
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Leading-edge SoIC hybrid bonding concentrated at TSMC.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Early HVM + high demand growth implies tightness.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Fine-pitch Cu-Cu bonding yield is a known manufacturing challenge.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: In volume at 6µm-class pitches; finer pitches still roadmap.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: New 3D flows require extensive customer quals.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Microbump paths cannot match density/power targets for SoIC use cases.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: TSMC SoIC/hybrid bonding capacity is concentrated at Taiwan AP campuses (e.g. Zhunan/Taichung).
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Critical for SoIC and denser HBM/logic stacking paths; rising on future GPU roadmaps.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary NVIDIA/TSMC collaboration quote; capacity CAGR mainly secondary.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Every incremental CoWoS start is yield-sensitive; multi-HBM packages amplify loss cost.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Effective capacity = tools × yield; TSMC stress on narrowing gap implicitly includes learning curves.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Learning improves effective output without new tools.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Yield learning locked inside TSMC CoWoS flows.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Primary risk dimension for this node by definition.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Yield windows part of customer specs.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Cannot outsource yield of a captive flow easily.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Yield learning for CoWoS-class packages is concentrated where TSMC runs those flows in Taiwan.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Directly scales shippable accelerators per wafer start.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK/MODERATE — yield numbers not disclosed; modeled from process physics + capacity gap context.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Final test required for each AI package.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Not singled out on TSMC calls; structural risk as package complexity rises.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Package-test queue pressure is inferred from rising multi-die complexity rather than disclosed ATE wait times.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Advanced package test capacity for AI parts is Asia-weighted around foundry/OSAT ecosystems.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK — few direct primary disclosures in this pass.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: AI scale-up still heavily electrical; NVIDIA CPO materials cite limits of electrical signaling at factory scale.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: SerDes IP/silicon not the scarce wafer constraint vs HBM/CoWoS.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Electrical SerDes for AI scale-up is a mature, repeatedly shipping technology versus first-gen CPO.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Can migrate traffic to optics over time — that is the point of CPO.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: SerDes implementation is geographically broad across multiple accelerator and switch vendors.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Still carries most near-term scale-up bandwidth.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary NVIDIA CPO rationale materials; SerDes scarcity itself less evidenced.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: NVIDIA CPO platforms integrate silicon photonics to scale AI factories; Spectrum-X Photonics H2 2026 availability stated.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Early HVM ecosystem (TSMC + partners); capacity not yet commodity.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: NVIDIA ecosystem names TSMC and specialty photonics partners — concentrated leading edge.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Photonic yield historically challenging vs pure CMOS.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Shipping/ramping CPO switches; not yet ubiquitous.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Pluggables remain substitute but with power/density penalties NVIDIA quantifies.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Foundation for CPO scale-out networking (and future package optical I/O).
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Strong primary NVIDIA disclosures; accelerator-package optical I/O still earlier than switch CPO.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: CPO switches require integrated optical engines on package.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Engine assembly is a new high-volume manufacturing flow per NVIDIA technical materials.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Detachable fiber attach and engine yield called out as manufacturing focus.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Without engines, CPO switches do not ship.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary product/tech blogs; limited independent capacity audits.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: NVIDIA positions CPO as required to scale AI factories to millions of GPUs with major power/resiliency gains.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Quantum-X then Spectrum-X phased availability (2025–2026); not yet broad HVM commodity.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Staged platform introductions indicate rapid intended growth from small base.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: NVIDIA-led CPO switch stack with TSMC photonics/SoIC.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Pluggables substitute at efficiency cost; not equivalent at scale targets.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Scale-across networking for AI factories; later may bind package I/O.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary NVIDIA newsroom + product pages; accelerator-on-package CPO still less evidenced than switch CPO.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: NVIDIA claims CPO innovations use 4x fewer lasers vs traditional methods — lasers remain necessary.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Named ecosystem includes Coherent, Lumentum; scarcity not proven in primary NVIDIA materials.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Specialty laser suppliers; not infinitely deep.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Insufficient primary evidence of allocation crisis.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Laser reliability matters; limited public yield data.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Multiple laser vendors exist; architecture can reduce count.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Required for engines but mitigated by fewer-lasers designs.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK — ecosystem named; no strong primary capacity-crunch evidence.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: HBM stacking + SoIC hybrid bonding both consume advanced bonders as volumes scale.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Secondary supply-chain notes Besi/AMAT/TEL benefit from SoIC/HBM bonding demand; tool lead times historically long.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Tool makers ramp but semiconductor equipment lead times lag.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Capital equipment lead times typically multi-quarter.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Tools themselves mature; process recipes vary.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: New hybrid bonders require fab process-of-record qualification before they add usable stacking capacity.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Limited alternate bonder ecosystems for leading hybrid bonding.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: EU/US/JP tool makers; install base in Asia fabs.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Gates both HBM cube output and SoIC.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: MODERATE — demand link strong; tool scarcity evidence mostly secondary.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Fine-pitch bonding and large interposers require heavy inspection/metrology.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Typically scales with packaging; rarely disclosed as headline bottleneck.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Metrology enables yield; node risk is throughput.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Some sampling strategies reduce need but cannot eliminate.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Metrology tools come from a global vendor set but installs concentrate in Asia packaging/HBM fabs.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK/MODERATE — physically motivated; thin primary citations.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: HBM + AI package test content rising with complexity.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Structural; not a TSMC earnings headline.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Test quality risk more than tool yield.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: ATE platforms are mature while AI/HBM test content and protocols continue to evolve.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Customer and process test-program development gates effective use of new ATE capacity.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Hard to skip advanced test on AI parts.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: ATE vendors are global; installed advanced-test capacity for AI follows maker/foundry geography.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Shared dependency of HBM test and package test.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: WEAK — included as connecting equipment node; sparse primary capacity evidence.
